Kolo, a variety spoken in Kolo (and presumably Tolo-Weri) in Bima Regency
(**hh:w:Jonker:Kolosche**, **hh:typ:Partami:Kolo**), appears to be a distinct language most closely related to Bima proper [bhp]
(**hh:hv:GrimesEdwards:Austronesian-Eastern-Indonesia**:97), but is listed only as a dialect thereof in E16/E17/E18/E19/E20/E21/E22/E23/E24/E25/E26/E27/E28/E29. See also: Bima [bhp].
